# Kickoff Project

## Objective
Align business and technical understanding before implementation.

## Context
FIAP Tech Challenge 02 — MovieLens 20M, PyTorch, DVC, MLflow, Docker. See `.cursor/context/project-goals.md`.

## Instructions
Senior ML architect role:

1. List functional requirements (recommendation, pipeline, metrics, registry)
2. List non-functional requirements (reproducibility, containerization, coverage)
3. Identify risks (data size, cold start, leakage, TMDB API)
4. Propose high-level architecture (layers + DVC stages + MLflow)

## Constraints
- No code generation
- Reference PyTorch/DVC/MLflow explicitly
- Structured output in pt-BR or en per team preference

## Output
Requirements doc, risks, proposed architecture diagram (Mermaid)
